descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment with an area of 89m², located on Rruga Idriz Breznica, in Fushë Kosovë.

The apartment is on the 9th floor, in a building by Model Slovenia, and faces East.
The space consists of a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom, a storage room and a balcony. The property has underfloor heating.

The property has an ownership certificate.
The price of the property is €72,500.

images.reason: cover label "Rruga Idriz Breznica, Fushë Kosovë." and "72,500€" (matches caption)
kitchen and dining table with doors to hallway
balcony with view over neighbouring buildings

notes: Parsed developer "Model Slovenia" comes from "në objekt nga Model Slovenia" ("in a building by Model Slovenia"); kept as it attributes the building to a named party, but the wording is not the usual "ndërtim nga" — maintainer may want to confirm Model Slovenia is the builder. No price per m² stated. No images excluded.
